# Get the current song and the full list of liked songs
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
print("Current song:", current)

# Get all liked songs (paginate)
liked_songs = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not batch:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(batch)
    if len(batch) < 20:
        break
    page += 1

liked_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in liked_songs}
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_ids)

        print("No liked song found in cycle")
        break
    visited.add(current_song_id)
    # Go to previous song
